counting_rule: A parameter-tuning family is one experiment series; byte-identical delivery mirrors and replay-only handoffs are not counted again.

canonical_baseline.note: AGENTS.md defines this path as canonical, but it was absent during the read-only audit. This task did not delete, move, restore, or replace it.

experiments.name: Screw1 v2 baseline and seed-replay diagnostics
experiments.strategy: Frozen acquisition plans, wrist/action authority probes, contact handoff and dual-contact regulator variants
experiments.reset_count_note: The 45 historical variant directories do not expose one trustworthy aggregate reset count.
experiments.direct_failure_reason: No repeatable safe dual target contact progressed into close and lift.

root_causes.cause: The baseline remained in acquisition/contact-handoff diagnostics rather than a repeatable grasp state.
The total number of fresh resets across all variants cannot be reconstructed from the available summaries.

ruled_out: 26D action authority and runtime joint ordering were exercised in dedicated variants.
experiments.lesson: Do not treat near-bank or contact-handoff diagnostics as grasp evidence; require an aggregate run contract before creating many variants.

experiments.name: Morphology-aware contact-adaptive Screw1 closure
experiments.strategy: Other-hand timing prior, 40-probe Wuji morphology calibration, frozen caging replay and synergy closure
experiments.reset_count_note: 40 calibration probes plus 7 reported A/B trials; calibration resets are diagnostics, not grasp candidates.
experiments.direct_failure_reason: The nominal distal-joint synergy reached guarded non-target contact before dual Screw1 contact.

root_causes.cause: Pre-contact motion did not consume the calibrated fingertip effect matrix and produced no dual target contact.

cannot_prove: Which non-target body caused the residual contact without actor-pair evidence
experiments.lesson: A transferable timing prior does not define object-relative contact geometry or a viable approach path.

experiments.name: Screw1 object-relative pre-contact Jacobian recovery
experiments.strategy: Frozen replay followed by endpoint 6x8 local active Jacobian calibration and guarded DLS eligibility
experiments.direct_failure_reason: Joint and fingertip restore errors exceeded the repeatability gates, so the measured Jacobian was not used.

root_causes.cause: The matrix was rank 6 and well conditioned, but endpoint restore error was 0.000725 rad and 1.068 mm.

ruled_out: Structural rank deficiency of the measured 6x8 matrix
cannot_prove: Whether slower transactional restore would make the controller usable
experiments.lesson: Validate repeated common endpoints before interpreting a local Jacobian as a runtime controller model.

experiments.name: Screw1 vectorized near-grasp CEM
experiments.strategy: 16D GraspProgram, PCA6 Wuji fallback prior, mixed CEM and strict physical evaluator
experiments.direct_failure_reason: Only two target contacts occurred and both hard-aborted at 6.31 N and 16.50 N; no simultaneous contact or stable close occurred.

root_causes.cause: The ranking admitted zero-contact low-motion elites because contact geometry was not dominant enough.
362 candidates had unresolved contact residuals that could not be assigned to a collider.

ruled_out: A replayable lift existing in the CEM artifacts
cannot_prove: GraspProgram parameterization insufficiency after only five generations
experiments.lesson: Search metrics must prefer safe contact over no contact, while strict success remains a separate evaluator.

experiments.name: Privileged Physics Grasp v1 Plug2 Gate A
experiments.strategy: Surface contact synthesis, Wuji IK, strict candidate filter and oracle reset Gate A
experiments.direct_failure_reason: All four formal candidates failed 0/5 through hard force, multi-contact hold failure, or contact instrumentation limits.

root_causes.cause: Offline candidate targets did not produce a safe stable runtime hold.

ruled_out: Absence of any optimized Plug2 candidate
Gate B/C accidentally running after Gate A failure
cannot_prove: That all Plug2 grasp topologies are infeasible
experiments.lesson: Oracle-reset Gate A is a physics diagnostic, not an autonomous grasp or full-route result.

experiments.name: Plug2 Gate A Forensic v2
experiments.strategy: Raycast same-section contacts, friction-cone gravity wrench, support vertices, forensic same-frame trace and sequential Gate A
experiments.direct_failure_reason: All 16 candidates failed 0/5: 75 multi-contact hold failures and 5 hard-force aborts.

root_causes.cause: Runtime tip-to-target residuals were approximately 20.459-40.984 mm.
Pinocchio-versus-Isaac FK disagreement was too small to explain the 20-41 mm target residual.

ruled_out: Large cross-engine FK mapping error as the principal blocker
cannot_prove: Which alternative contact topology would succeed
experiments.lesson: A precise trace cannot rescue a candidate whose runtime target geometry is centimeters away.

experiments.name: Multi-Object Privileged Physical Grasp v3
experiments.strategy: Runtime mesh audit, multi-seed staged M0 synthesis, strict M0 loader and Plug2 Gate A
experiments.direct_failure_reason: Strict M0 blocked every large object from physics; the sole Plug2 strict candidate failed both Gate A batches.

root_causes.cause: Large objects were mostly reachable but had zero strict candidates because residual/collision/path requirements were coupled before physics.
Zero strict M0 proves mechanical grasp infeasibility.

ruled_out: Raw Stage A reachability as the sole blocker for Rod and Backrest
Automatic PPO or old CEM execution
cannot_prove: Physical behavior of Rod, Backrest, Frame or Screw1 candidates because they had zero resets
experiments.lesson: Use strict M0 as acceptance, not the only development doorway into informative low-risk physics tests.

experiments.name: Frame Physical Delivery RC1 cage proof
experiments.strategy: Twelve deterministic HOOK/WRAP/BRACKET mechanical cage candidates with geometry gate before physics
experiments.direct_failure_reason: No candidate passed the geometry gate, so the proof correctly performed zero physical candidate resets.

root_causes.cause: Scene-query control rays missed both the opening and bars, so HOOK topology could not be verified.
The central hole was physically filled or Frame grasping was mechanically impossible.

ruled_out: An RC1 physical rollout failure; no candidate rollout occurred
experiments.lesson: A scene-query instrumentation limitation must not be promoted into a mechanical feasibility conclusion.

experiments.name: Frame Stage 4 Physical Delivery RC2
experiments.strategy: One fixed three-finger fork support pose, one baseline rollout and one measured -5 mm height correction
experiments.direct_failure_reason: Baseline hit 119.5378 N on frame-filtered finger2 link3; correction_1 removed hand-Frame force but Frame moved 19.1769 mm in three frames and triggered FRAME_JUMP.

root_causes.cause: The baseline fork reset had severe hand-Frame penetration or impact.
Frame moved 19.1769 mm during correction_1's first three frames.
The correction_1 jump was specifically a Frame-FixedAsset collision.
Actor-pair attribution identified the exact collision body.

ruled_out: Sticky, snap, proxy, fixed joint or object-follow assistance
cannot_prove: The exact collider responsible for correction_1
Whether the fixed fork pose can support Frame after a collision-free reset
experiments.lesson: Do not derive a large correction from an already-colliding frame without an independent collision-free measurement; bind published video and numeric result to the same attempt.

reproduction_handoffs.name: Frozen Screw1 near-grasp replay handoff
reproduction_handoffs.result: Candidate 373 reproduced NO_GRASP_CONTACT; candidate 33 reproduced TARGET_CONTACT_HARD_ABORT. These are synchronized failure videos, not new search results.
